name: list-cycles
description: Lists Linear cycles (sprints: past, current and upcoming), up to 50, across every team or for one team: each cycle's id, number, name, start and end and progress, and its team's id and key. A cycle's id is the cycleId linear__create-issue takes.

teamId.description: Narrows the list to one team's cycles: a team's id from linear__list-teams.
